title: DocumentClassification
description: A proposed classification of one tender document, produced by the local model only for documents the deterministic rules could not settle. Pure data contract: it has no field that names an operation, changes any record, or identifies a BOQ line. Every value is a proposal that a person confirms before anything is routed (see app/services/tender_intake.py).

doc_class.description: What kind of tender document this is.

sub_type.description: For drawings only: the discipline. Null for every other class or when unclear.

confidence.description: Honest overall confidence from 0 to 1 in doc_class.

evidence_quote.description: A short verbatim quote (under 200 characters) from the document that justifies doc_class. Null if there is no text to quote.

evidence_page.description: 1-based page the quote came from. Null if unknown.

metadata.description: Fields printed on the document. Null when absent or not legible; never guess.

supersedes.description: For addenda: documents or drawings the addendum replaces or amends, as printed (e.g. 'C-101 Rev A').

header_row.description: For a BOQ spreadsheet: 1-based row holding the column headings.
